episodes.name: Groot's First Steps
episodes.overviewEn: Baby Groot takes his first steps out of his pot, only to learn you have to walk before you can run.

episodes.name: The Little Guy
episodes.overviewEn: Groot discovers a miniature civilization that believes the seemingly enormous tree toddler is the hero they’ve been waiting for.

episodes.name: Groot's Pursuit
episodes.overviewEn: Groot investigates a spooky noise that’s been haunting the Quadrant, which leads to an intense dance off.

episodes.name: Groot Takes a Bath
episodes.overviewEn: Everybody needs some alone time to relax and wash up, but things go quite differently when you’re a Flora Colossi toddler.

episodes.name: Magnum Opus
episodes.overviewEn: Groot sets out to paint a family portrait of himself and the Guardians, only to discover just how messy the artistic process can be.

episodes.name: Are You My Groot?
episodes.overviewEn: Groot stumbles across a strange egg in a nest while exploring the alien planet of Terma. He instantly falls for the little creature that emerges when the egg cracks, adopting it as his own.

episodes.name: Groot Noses Around
episodes.overviewEn: When Groot discovers a bionic nose-shaped device that grants him a sense of smell, he quickly learns not to stick his new nose where it doesn't belong.

episodes.name: Groot's Snow Day
episodes.overviewEn: After landing on the icy planet of Falligar, Groot fashions a snowman with scraps of junk, inadvertently creating an unstoppable snowman-robot that wreaks havoc.

episodes.name: Groot's Sweet Treat
episodes.overviewEn: As an intergalactic ice cream truck approaches, Groot—desperate to get a treat— frantically scours the ship for coins

episodes.name: Groot and the Great Prophecy
episodes.overviewEn: In this adventure narrated by The Watcher, Groot finds himself in the heart of an ancient Drez-Lar temple with a mythic prophecy he must fulfill to save the universe.
